## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Financials). Confirmation: very narrow sector strength (only Energy and Financials up) and broad weakness across Tech/Healthcare/ConsStaples; leadership concentrated across 3 sectors (Energy, Financials, Tech) so signals are mixed.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing short-term lift: MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.59% | 1M: -9.39%) RECOVERY. Style: Value/Cyclical.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -30.37%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -15.97%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare and Real Estate also lag: LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND, VTR (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -4.76%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5 (SP100 focus): SLB (1W: +9.54% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY, LRCX (1W: +6.34% | 1M: -4.63%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.84% | 1M: +15.07%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -30.37%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -10.94% | 1M: -19.48%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -14.49%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Staples/Healthcare/Selected Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: SLB (1W: +9.54% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY, LRCX (1W: +6.34% | 1M: -4.63%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY. Note major short-term divergence: multiple large names up 1W but down 1M → tactical bounces, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech broadly soft: AAPL (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.24% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND, while AMAT (1W: +4.51% | 1M: -3.62%) RECOVERY and LRCX (1W: +6.34% | 1M: -4.63%) RECOVERY are pockets of strength; sector breadth: negative.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Patchy strength: MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.59% | 1M: -9.39%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -6.72%) RECOVERY, while V (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; sector breadth: one of two positive sectors supporting neutral stance.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mostly weak: UNH (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND, with PFE (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND an outlier; sector breadth: weak.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and selective Financials (CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY); reduce exposure to large-cap Tech showing uniform weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND). Given NEUTRAL regime and short-term divergences, prioritize tactical sizing and wait for confirmations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNH (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.57%) showing clear above-trend names.  
BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Healthcare showing concentrated weakness and headline risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
CVX continuation above recent highs would confirm Energy leadership; watch CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor NVDA (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND for breakdown confirmation; JPM (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -6.72%) RECOVERY holding above this week’s range would validate Financials bounce.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (+80): BA (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -14.49%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price deteriorating (divergence).  
MDT (+80): MDT not in detailed returns here—watch for follow-through; if price confirms, Industrials momentum may broaden.  
AVGO (+55): AVGO not in detailed returns here—positive AI revenue headline to monitor for tech accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (-60): UNH (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND — news aligns with price weakness (confirmed).  
PFE (-50): PFE (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND — negative study headline vs rising price (divergence).  
AMZN (-50): AMZN (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +0.01%) TREND EXHAUSTION — operational headline with limited price reaction, watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favoring Value/Cyclical style given Energy and Financials pockets of strength. CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while Tech leaders AAPL (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND remain at risk; monitor major short-term divergences and headline-driven names (UNH, PFE, BA) for confirmation.
